cards.title: Rounding and benchmarks: quick review
cards.body: Round with the digit to the right: $5$ or more rounds up. Steps to the next ten or hundred are bonds: $47 \to 50$ is $3$, $370 \to 400$ is $30$. Bonds to $1000$: $370 + 630$.

cards.title: Fifty and twenty-five: quick review
cards.body: Times $50$: times $100$, then halve. Times $25$: times $100$, then halve twice. $16 \times 25 = 1600 \div 4 = 400$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.
